"''You hunt Jedi.|The Grand Inquisitor and the saloon owner|}} A [[human]] [[Gender|male]] was the '''owner''' of a [[Unidentified saloon|saloon]] in the [[spaceport]] [[city]] [[Mos Eisley]] on the [[planet]] [[Tatooine]]. He had trouble with thieves threatening and stealing from him, but was saved by [[9 BBY]] when the fugitive [[Jedi]] [[Nari]] intervened. The proprietor offered Nari a place to hide in his saloon, but rapidly spreading stories led the Jedi-hunting [[Inquisitorius]] to the saloon. [[The Grand Inquisitor]], the Inquisitorius leader, questioned the saloon owner and accused him of hiding a Jedi. Another Inquisitor, the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]], then threw a [[knife]] at the proprietor, prompting Nari to reveal himself by saving the owner. The Jedi escaped the saloon, but was soon intercepted and killed by the Inquisitors. ==Biography== {{Quote|Perhaps the locals are stealing from you. Threatening you. So what is the Jedi to do? Help you and risk exposure? Or move on?|The Grand Inquisitor recounts Nari finding the saloon owner|}} [[File:BarkeepTendsBar-OWKpI.png|thumb|left|300px|The saloon owner tends the bar in his establishment.]] The [[human]] [[Gender|male]] owned a [[Unidentified saloon|saloon]] in the [[spaceport]] [[city]] of [[Mos Eisley]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Tatooine]] during the [[Imperial Era|time]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. He had trouble with locals stealing from his business, threatening and injuring the proprietor in the process. However, by [[9 BBY]],{{KenobiDate|I}} ten [[Standard year|years]] after the [[Great Jedi Purge|purge]] of the [[Jedi Order]], the [[Jedi]] [[Nari]] came across the [[Cantina|saloon]] and learned of the owner's troubles with thieves. Standing by his [[Jedi Code]], Nari rescued the saloon from the thieves, leaving [[lightsaber]] marks on the establishment's walls, and so the proprietor offered to let the Jedi, whose kind were fugitives of the Empire, hide in his saloon. Unfortunately for Nari, his heroic actions drew attention, and stories of him saving the saloon spread quickly, reaching the [[Inquisitorius]], a group of [[Force-sensitive]] Jedi hunters who worked for the Empire. [[The Grand Inquisitor]], leader of the Inquisitorius, arrived at Mos Eisley with two other Inquisitors, the [[Reva Sevander|Third Sister]] and [[Fifth Brother]]. The trio walked over to the saloon, where the proprietor was working and Nari was seated. Noticing his new visitors, the saloon owner approached the Grand Inquisitor, who confirmed with the man that he knew who the Inquisitors were and what they did. [[File:BarkeepFacesGrandInq-OWKpI.png|thumb|right|300px|The Grand Inquisitor confronts the saloon owner.]] The Grand Inquisitor talked about the key to hunting Jedi and the widespread rumors about Jedi that the Inquisitorius dealt with. The Inquisitor then brought up the stories of Nari coming across and saving the saloon from thieves. At the end of it, the Grand Inquisitor accused the proprietor of hiding Nari and giving him fresh [[water]]. As the Inquisitor did so, the Third Sister impulsively threw a [[knife]] at the saloon owner, leading Nari to reveal himself by stopping the blade with [[the Force]] before it could [[Death|kill]] the proprietor. As the Jedi made his escape, the Inquisitors tried to intercept him, but failed to fully capture the fugitive when the Grand Inquisitor had to stop the Third Sister from killing Nari. Although Nari got away at first, he was later intercepted and killed by the Inquisitors. ==Behind the scenes== The saloon owner first appeared in the first episode, "[[Part I]]," of the [[Disney+]] live-action television series [[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|''Obi Wan Kenobi'']], directed by [[Deborah Chow]] and released on [[May 26]], [[2022]].{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi|Obi-Wan Kenobi]]|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}} Credited as "Saloon Owner," the character was played by [[Derek Basco]]. Scenes with the proprietor were first shown in the teaser trailer for ''Obi-Wan Kenobi'', posted on YouTube on [[March 9]], 2022.{{SWYouTube|TWTfhyvzTx0|Obi-Wan Kenobi | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/teaser-trailer-obi-wan-kenobi}} ==Appearances== *{{Kenobi|Part I}} {{1st}} *[[Obi-Wan Kenobi 1|''Obi-Wan Kenobi'' 1]] ==Sources== *{{SWYouTube|TWTfhyvzTx0|Obi-Wan Kenobi | Teaser Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/teaser-trailer-obi-wan-kenobi}} {{1stp}} *{{ThisWeek|wAfaGz8SUXU|Obi-Wan Kenobi Teaser Trailer, Behind the Scenes of LEGO Star Wars: The Skywalker Saga, and More!|sw_url=video/obi-wan-kenobi-teaser-trailer-behind-the-scenes-of-lego-star-wars-the-skywalker-saga-and-more}} *{{SWYouTube|gEuirQWecEw|Obi-Wan Kenobi | Announcement | Disney+|sw_url=video/obi-wan-kenobi-announcement}} *{{ThisWeek|trKV0AObfgg|Obi-Wan Kenobi Series Premiere Update, LEGO Republic Fighter Tank Reveal, and More!|sw_url=video/obi-wan-kenobi-series-premiere-update-lego-republic-fighter-tank-reveal-and-more}} *{{SWYouTube|3Yh_6_zItPU|Obi-Wan Kenobi | Official Trailer | Disney+|sw_url=video/official-trailer-obi-wan-kenobi}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი სალუნის მფლობელი }} [[Category:Business owners and executives]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Males]]
